notes: imd/acc Sepolia test run 3, the third and last before mainnet, from the launch-sepolia branch (the sepolia branch without .github/workflows). One contract: ProjectRegistry(intake, oracleAsset, stacker, oracleSigner, questionChainId, challengeBond, challengeCooldown) = (IdentityMD Intake v2 0xa43e...de82; the Sepolia test IMD 0x44a1...f89a the Intake is paid in, which anyone can mint; test run 2's live Stacker 0x0457...314d of launch #1294; the oracle signer 0x5598...2982; chain id 1, because the oracle has no Sepolia RPC, so questions are filed under chain 1 and name Sepolia in their text; a 5 test-IMD challenge bond; a 3600-second challenge cooldown). This is the code the mainnet registry will use, with Sepolia settings; it asks the oracle panel one yes-or-no question per application or challenge through requestWithFailure, with the 8 rules of version 2 (docs/panel-rules-v2.md), each under 512 characters, and this run tests those rules live (applications, a listing and a challenge). Nothing else is deployed: no Stacker, TestIMD or TestSIMD. The live Stacker runs src/Stacker.sol byte for byte on the live TestIMD 0x2b69...1e82 and TestSIMD 0xf9e2...1cc1 of launch #1129 (test/SepoliaFork.t.sol checks it), PLEA's hook already credits through it, and the registry only names it in its questions and never calls it. The registry has no owner, so no $owner argument; its constructor makes no external call. Anyone calls applyListing(project, name, sourceUrl, rateBps 25-100, beneficiary) or, for a listed project, challengeForBeneficiary(project, reason, beneficiary), paying the oracle fee read live from the Intake (ORACLE_FEE(), 0.5 test IMD) plus the bond for a challenge. onOracleResult accepts only the Intake, only its own open request, each answer once, only a signature by the oracle signer for this contract issued after the ask (300-second tolerance), from a panel of 15 with at least 11 agreeing: yes lists from that block, or keeps a challenged project (bond to its beneficiary, cooldown not restarted); no rejects, or delists from that block (bond back). onOracleFailure only clears the open question and returns a bond; expire clears one after a day or once the Intake completed it. setBeneficiary waits while a question is open and changes the wallet at most once per day (HANDOFF_INTERVAL, HandoffTooSoon otherwise): the fix from the audit of job 6478f77c, whose delivery was refused on a workflow file and never deployed; this commit carries the fix and no workflow. Test doubles under test/mocks and test/trial are not deployed. Runtime 22,294 bytes; deployment estimated at about 35.2M gas on Sepolia. Once live, the address goes into the README Deployments table as "Sepolia test run 3".
